decisions.reason: Changing the Unit 1 bathroom door from sliding to hinged does not necessarily alter the en-suite bathroom's confirmed type, room connection, or fixture locations.
The door-type change does not alter the requirement to show dimensions. The same message's separate requests for bathroom-door edge offsets and Unit 3 bathroom width are already represented.
The source decision changes only the Unit 1 bathroom door type and does not change Unit 3 bathroom geometry or fixture placement.
The Unit 1 bathroom door-type change has no necessary effect on Unit 3 toilet drain routing.
Changing a bathroom door from sliding to hinged does not necessarily modify any confirmed partition-wall attribute.
The bathroom door operation is independent of the open-plan kitchen cabinetry requirements.
The source does not state that the hinged Unit 1 bathroom door changes the common corridor or entrance-hall layout.
